name: Classic
direction: Closest careful polish of the original: same teal hood around blonde fringe, same violet cape and gray-teal outfit. Improve face, hood folds, sleeve cuffs, belt buckle and boot shapes with restrained detail. Keep familiar silhouette; this is the baseline, not a new costume.

name: Scholar
direction: Quiet learned mage: slightly more open teal hood, clear blonde fringe, composed narrow brows, high gray-teal cloth collar, pale muted trim along robe opening. Small brown scroll case at belt, hands empty. Keep violet rear cape and burgundy sash. Scholarly rather than elderly caricature.

name: Wanderer
direction: Travelling mage: weathered teal hood, short blonde fringe and calm mature face; violet travel cloak with a slightly irregular lower edge, layered gray-teal tunic, simple brown leather cuff wraps and a narrow utility belt pouch. Preserve original compact silhouette and readable feet.

name: Battle mage
direction: Practical battle mage: firm serious face beneath original teal hood, fitted slate-teal cloth, small muted brown leather shoulder reinforcement, broad burgundy waist belt and sturdy brown boots. Violet cloak remains behind. No plate armor, no helmet, no bulk or oversized muscles.

name: Mystic
direction: Refined mystic mage: original teal hood with one understated desaturated blue edge, blonde fringe framing the exposed face, violet cloak, softly layered gray-teal cloth. One tiny gold clasp at collar and subtle geometric seam at waist. Keep serious human face, no glow, no floating decorations.

name: Short mantle
direction: Agile mage: slightly shorter violet shoulder mantle rather than a long trailing cape, original teal hood and visible blonde fringe. Gray-teal fitted tunic with layered sleeve cuffs, small burgundy sash and brown boots. Calm adult face, lightweight robe details, no exaggerated proportions.

name: Archivist
direction: Experienced archivist mage: original hood and blonde fringe, firmer nose/brow, restrained gray-teal cloth folds. Violet cape, muted leather cross-body strap, one small closed book pouch attached to the belt (not held), burgundy waist wrap and sturdy boots. Sparse useful detailing.

name: Hood down
direction: Same recognizable mage with teal hood lowered around the shoulders, exposing swept blonde hair and a mature composed face; retain the hood's cloth at the back, violet short cloak, gray-teal tunic, burgundy belt and small gold-brown buckle. Preserve head size and overall compact original silhouette.

name: Deep cowl
direction: Reserved arcane mage: slightly deeper teal hood with soft shadow over the forehead, a small visible blonde fringe and a readable serious face (no mask). Violet rear cloak, layered gray-teal cloth collar, muted burgundy waist belt, dark boots. Avoid a faceless or black-clad assassin; retain original gentle palette.
